removed text: (my tentative gloss: "Mitra and Varuṇa are indeed his resolve and skill")

(Mine and tentative gloss: "Offer a food-rich word to the (bounteous one) who with Ṛjiśvan destroyed the black-wombed ones; desiring help, we invoke for friendship the bull, holding the thunderbolt in his right hand, the lord of the Maruts.")

(Mine and tentative gloss: "To you has been given, after, great vigour; always all is yours in the slaying of Vṛtra; after it, dominion; after it, might, O worthy of worship, Indra; with the gods, after, in the overcoming of men, [it is given] to you.")
